[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) A merge can be rejected in project docs even after the review approves, because the pre-merge check runs separately from acceptance verification; submitted work must also pass git diff --check (whitespace) before the pre-merge check lets it merge into main, and the ticket stays Resolved until the Lead closes it.
